target: leaf lamina adaxial epidermis (PO_0000050)
reason: Exact. Follows the curator decision of 2026-09-18 (rule R2700): 'leaf lower surface' maps to leaf lamina abaxial epidermis PO_0000049, because PO models surfaces as epidermis. The adaxial counterpart is PO_0000050. Glabrous, pilose, pruinose and scabrous are qualities of that surface.

target: trichome (PO_0000282) part of leaf midvein (PO_0020139), as a part with a fixed whole (bearer_container PO_0020139)
reason: In fern floras these are scales on the costa, the midrib of a pinna. 'scale' is a PO synonym of trichome, and 'vascular leaf costa' is a synonym of leaf midvein. Narrower: strictly, the fern costa is the pinna midvein, which has no class of its own.

target: trichome (PO_0000282) part of leaf rachis (PO_0020055), bearer_container PO_0020055
reason: Fern frond rachis scales. 'scale' is a PO synonym of trichome. Colour, shape (linear, hair-like), density and toothing are qualities of the scales.

target: awn (PO_0025349) part of sepal (PO_0009031), bearer_container PO_0009031
reason: An awn at the tip of a sepal. Presence or absence follows pattern 15. Caveat: PO defines awn only on a glume, lemma or palea (a grass-only definition); propose broadening it upstream rather than adding a class.

A character, not a structure. Axile, parietal, basal and free-central placentation are qualities of the gynoecium (PO_0009062): the arrangement of its placentas. Like 'venation', rejected on 2026-11-13. Do not ground it to PO 'placenta' (PO_0025078), which is the gametophyte-sporophyte interface of bryophytes.

target: plant organ margin (PO_0025005) part of fruit (PO_0009001), bearer_container PO_0009001
reason: A margin region of an existing class (margin pattern). Thickened, winged, ciliate and undulate are qualities of the edge of a flattened fruit (legume, samara).

target: branch (PO_0025073)
reason: Narrower. 'twig' is an exact PO synonym of branch. 'young' is the reviewed context word for young (PATO_0000309), given as a state of the bearer (pattern 04), not as a new class.

A process, not a structure ('Specialized asexual reproduction absent' in moss floras). If the statement is to be kept, read it as the presence or absence of asexual propagule (FLOPO_0986119) under pattern 15. The bare phrase is not a bearer. Same treatment as 'reproductive structure' (2026-11-14).

target: trichome (PO_0000282) part of sorus (PO_0025359), bearer_container PO_0025359
reason: Scales mixed in among the sporangia of a fern sorus. Not PO paraphysis (PO_0030070), which grows among gametangia. Presence, colour and shape are qualities of these scales.

Two senses in the examples. 'bourrelet intrastaminal' is an intrastaminal disc (floral disc, FLOPO_0986025). Elsewhere 'staminal ring' is a ring of connate filaments (staminal tube, FLOPO_0986013); 'reflexed' and the count '1' fit that sense. Each flora needs its own rule.

target: achene fruit (PO_0030107)
reason: Narrower. Papillose, smooth, glossy, reticulate and tuberculate are qualities of the achene's surface, stated of the achene, as 'stigmatic surface' maps to stigma (rule R2960). PO has no achene epidermis class.

target: plant organ lamina (PO_0025513) part of wing petal (PO_0025325), bearer_container PO_0025325
reason: The blade, as opposed to the claw, of a papilionoid wing petal. Auricled, obtuse apex, width and length are its qualities. The claw and auricle show that the wing is a petal here, not the petaloid wing sepal of Polygala.

target: petal (PO_0009032) part of staminate flower (PO_0025600): pattern 12, whole flower with male (PATO_0000384), or container PO_0025600
reason: A part of a qualified whole. 'staminate' is the reviewed context word for male on flower. Counts ('petals 3') follow pattern 03.

target: phyllome lamina vein (PO_0025348) part of palea (PO_0009038), bearer_container PO_0009038
reason: Narrower: the two keels of a grass palea are ridges along its two lateral veins. Ciliate, scabrid and smooth are their qualities. Do not use keel PO_0025327, which is the legume keel petal pair. If many floras need it, a FLOPO 'glumaceous bract keel' class could later replace this.

target: plant organ margin (PO_0025005) part of ligule (PO_0020105), bearer_container PO_0020105
reason: A margin region of an existing class. Ciliate, ciliolate, dentate, irregular and cartilaginous describe the edge of the leaf ligule (grasses, bamboos).

target: plant organ margin (PO_0025005) part of orchid labellum (FLOPO_0980978), bearer_container FLOPO_0980978
reason: A margin region. Undulate, fimbriate, crenulate, serrulate and incurving lateral margins are orchid-lip vocabulary, and the same floras describe the labellum callus. Restrict the rule to orchid treatments: in Lamiales floras 'lip' is corolla lip (FLOPO_0985017).

target: petal base (PO_0025146) part of keel (PO_0025327), bearer_container PO_0025327
reason: Narrower. Rule R2347 maps 'petal claw' to petal base, and the keel is made of two petals. Length and glabrousness are qualities of the claws of the keel petals.

label: stem internode wall
parent: is_a PO_0025498 (cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure); part_of PO_0020142 (stem internode)
definition: A cardinal part of multi-tissue plant structure that is the tissue of a hollow stem internode between its outer surface and its central cavity.
reason: Bamboo and grass floras give culm wall thickness as a key character (thin, thick, depth in mm). PO has no class for the wall of a hollow stem: pith and cortex do not fit, and a 'thickness' of the whole stem would be a different measurement. Propose it upstream to PO.

label: labellum callus
parent: is_a PO_0025001 (cardinal organ part); part_of FLOPO_0980978 (orchid labellum)
definition: A cardinal organ part that is a raised, often fleshy thickening or set of ridges on the adaxial surface of an orchid labellum, usually on its disc.
reason: A real structure that every orchid treatment uses, with its own shape (horseshoe-shaped, trifid, flabellate, winged). Bare 'callus' stays rejected as generic. Not PO plant callus (PO_0005052), which is undifferentiated tissue. A precedent is floret callus (FLOPO_0986120) for grasses. Propose to PO upstream together with labellum.

target: spine leaf (PO_0025173) part of areole bud (PO_0025353), position median (FLOPO_0991381) (pattern 18)

target: plant organ apex (FLOPO_0985023) part of lemma (PO_0009037), bearer_container PO_0009037

reason: A base region of an existing class. Auriculate, cuneate, oblique, adnate and not narrowed are base shapes. 'acroscopic' and 'basiscopic' name the two sides of the base, which the patterns do not model.

Ambiguous without context: the stem, a first order inflorescence axis, a rhizome or a non-vascular thallus axis. '250-400 µm in diameter' points to a bryophyte or alga, unlike most uses.

The number of branching orders is a quality (branched, PATO_0000402, with a count) of the axis or inflorescence being described. Same as 'branching order' and 'orders of branching' (2026-11-14).
